conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Officer Martin from the IRS Refunds Department. Am I speaking to Mr. Thompson?
Yes, this is him. What's this about?

I'm contacting you regarding your 2023 tax filings. It appears you're eligible for a government-issued stimulus refund, but there are some minor discrepancies we must address before releasing your funds.
A refund? I wasn't aware I was getting anything back. Are you sure this is for me?
Yes, according to our IRS system, you're due a refund of $1,850. However, due to new federal security measures, there is a mandatory identity verification fee to finalize the process.
I've never heard of having to pay a fee to get a refund. Is that a new thing? I've been retired for a while.
The IRS recently implemented these procedures to clamp down on fraud, especially for individuals receiving federal benefits or pensions. It's a security step to protect your funds.
I get a lot of calls about scams. How do I know this isn't one?

Mr. Thompson, you are speaking directly to a verified IRS collections officer. If you refuse to comply, your refund will be placed on indefinite hold, and your eligibility for future payments could be affected.
That doesn't sound good. I count on my pension and benefits. What do I have to do?
To verify your identity and clear the refund, you must pay a $295 processing fee today. This needs to be completed within the next hour, or your file will be flagged for non-compliance.
I don't have that kind of money lying around. How do I pay the fee?
We accept payment via Apple gift cards, Google Play gift cards, or cryptocurrency transfer. These are secure, IRS-approved channels. Which method can you use today?
I'm not sure... I've never used those before. Can't I just pay by check or debit card?

Unfortunately, due to the urgency and fraud prevention, only gift cards or crypto are allowed for this verification process. If you fail to complete payment, you risk the IRS initiating a formal review of your tax account.
Alright, I guess I can go to the store and get a gift card. Do I just call you back?
Stay on the line, please. Once you purchase the gift cards, read me the codes from the back. That way, I can process your verification instantly and release your refund.
This just feels strange. Are you sure this is the only way?
Mr. Thompson, if you do not comply, your refund will be forfeited and your file flagged for possible tax evasion, which could result in fines or even a lien on your benefits.
Okay, okay, no need to get upset. I'll head to the store now. How many cards do I need?
You need to purchase two Apple gift cards for $150 each. Once you have them, scratch off the codes and give them to me over the phone.
Alright, I'll do that. Just promise there won't be any deductions from my pension?
If you follow my directions, your refund will be processed within two hours, and no further action will be taken against your benefits.
Alright, I'll get the cards and be back in about 20 minutes.
Thank you. I will remain on the line. Please confirm as soon as you have the cards so we can proceed.
